purpose: Canonical code-write ingress policy. Code-changing candidates must cross the repository-owned pre-push boundary before review progression.

github_contents_api.reason: Direct Contents API commits bypass the repository-local pre-push boundary.

github_git_data_api.reason: Direct Git Data API ref/commit writes bypass the repository-local pre-push boundary.

ingress_provenance.binding: The signature is computed over the commit object itself, so the commit SHA is the signed identity. A proof cannot be detached, replayed onto another SHA, or supplied as Contents API or Git Data API commit metadata.
ingress_provenance.authority_source: Read from the trusted default branch by the governance controller, never from the candidate head, so a candidate cannot widen its own allowlist or move its own attestation floor.
ingress_provenance.attested_from_reason: Last commit created before this ingress authority existed. Commits reachable from this floor predate the regime; every later code-changing commit in a pull request range requires a verified signature from an authorized signer.
ingress_provenance.scope: every code-changing commit in the pull request range, not only the tip
ingress_provenance.fail_closed: Missing policy, empty allowlist, unavailable commit-range evidence, unsigned commit, unverified signature, or unauthorized signer all block candidate admission.
